items.name: Geethanjali Monsoon Open 2018

venue.name: [Geethanjali College Of Engineering And Technology](http://www.geethanjaliinstitutions.com/engineering/index.html)
venue.address: Geethanjali College Of Engineering And Technology, Cheeryala, Keesara.

items.information: Partipants needs to pre-register for the event in WCA as they will not be allowed to do any spot registrations on 25th August 2018 to participate. Participation registration for the event closes on 22nd August 2018 at 9:00pm IST. Payment also should be made before 22nd August 2018 9:00pm IST. Please note once you register in WCA site for the Geethanjali Monsoon Open 2018, your name will be in waiting list and once your payment is done then your name will appear in competitors list in 1-2 days. All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except New comers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to Judge (or) Scramble for the entire event, all this will be decided by the organising team and will be informed 2 days before the event, we will make sure that your volunteering will not affect your main events. Additional information will be provided in the tabs.

items.name: Kursk Open 2018
items.information: Registration will be closed at midnight on August, 22 or when we reach 70 competitors. Spectators are welcome and do not need to register or pay. Registration fee: * **100 RUB (~2 USD)** for any one event (for ex. 3x3x3 Cube only); * **200 RUB (~4 USD)** for any 2-3 events; * **300 RUB (~6 USD)** for any 4 events and more; If you do not see your name on the compeitors table after 48 hours of registering, please [contact us](mailto:g.sloboda@mail.ru,Lexkov27@gmail.com) to resolve the issue. Visit the competition [website](https://vk.com/kurskopen2018) for more details.
